ZBRA.thesis_one_line: Barcode-scanner and rugged-computer leader riding a real recovery, but growth is still partly a rebound from 2023 destocking plus Elo acquisition, not fully organic.
kill_criteria: Full-year 2026 organic (ex-M&A/FX) net sales growth falls below 6% for two consecutive quarters
Non-GAAP diluted EPS guidance is cut from the current $20.75-$21.25 FY2026 range at either of the next two quarterly reports
Net debt/EBITDA (long-term debt plus current borrowings) rises above 2.5x
Adjusted operating margin falls back below 22% for two consecutive quarters
A securities-related investigation or restatement is disclosed
key_adverse_facts: About 8 points of the guided FY2026 14-16% sales growth is from M&A/FX (Elo Touch), not organic growth
TTM free cash flow (~$577M per quant snapshot) trails management's own FY2026 FCF guide of at least $900M, a gap to reconcile next quarter
Trailing GAAP diluted P/E is ~34x versus ~17.6x on adjusted EPS; any narrowing of the GAAP/adjusted gap or growth disappointment hits the stock disproportionately
A 2023 securities class action alleged the company understated post-acquisition weaknesses before a prior guidance cut (historical, outside this dossier's window, monitor only)
data_conflicts: Quant snapshot TTM FCF (~$577M) is below the company's stated FY2026 guide of >=$900M FCF; likely a TTM-timing/working-capital effect around the Elo integration rather than an error, flagged for next-quarter reconciliation
ZBRA.confidence_in_thesis: medium - strong recent execution and two consecutive guidance raises, but the durability of growth once the destocking snapback and M&A contribution fade is unproven
ZBRA.scenario_basis: Starting FY2026E adjusted EPS ~$21 (midpoint of $20.75-$21.25 guide); base case ~8-10% p.a. adjusted EPS growth as cyclical snapback fades into structural mid/high-single-digit growth, exit multiple held near current ~17-18x adjusted; bear case growth decelerates to flat and multiple compresses to ~14x; bull case sustained mid-teens growth with multiple expansion to ~20x; no dividend of note in the return math.

BF-B.thesis_one_line: Jack Daniel's owner at a fair, already-discounted price, but management itself is guiding organic operating income to keep falling this year.
kill_criteria: Organic net sales for FY2027 print below -2% at any quarterly update versus the reaffirmed "approximately flat" full-year guide
Fiscal 2027 organic operating-income guidance is cut below the current -3% to -5% range
Canadian sales remain off-shelf/boycotted for more than two full fiscal years from the initial 2025 disruption
The dividend is cut or its multi-decade growth streak is broken
key_adverse_facts: Canadian sales fell about 62% in fiscal Q2 2026 amid a boycott/delisting of US spirits, with Jack Daniel's expected to remain off shelves in most of Canada through the rest of the fiscal year, per company commentary as of September 2026

The EU has settled on a 25% tariff on American whiskey; third-party analyst estimates cited in September 2026 coverage suggest a 50% EU tariff scenario could be roughly a 10-point hit to EBIT (analyst estimate, not company guidance)
Fiscal 2027 guidance (reaffirmed 2026-09-02) is for organic operating income to DECLINE 3-5%, not merely flat sales
Sazerac made an unsolicited ~$15B bid that was rejected, a live overhang/distraction even though a deal is unlikely given family dual-class control
BF-B.confidence_in_thesis: medium - valuation is fair and cash generation is solid, but the near-term earnings trajectory is company-guided down, so conviction to buy now (rather than wait for a turn) is limited
BF-B.scenario_basis: Starting TTM FCF ~$686M and trailing dividend yield ~3.5%; base case organic sales return to low-single-digit growth by FY2029 as the Canada disruption partially resolves, multiple holds near current ~15x NTM plus the dividend; bear case continued volume decline and unresolved tariffs with multiple compressing to ~12x; bull case US spirits demand troughs, Canada partially restored, multiple re-rates to ~18x.

CMG.thesis_one_line: Best-in-class burrito chain whose traffic has finally turned positive, but the stock is priced for growth well beyond what its own margin trend and guidance support.
kill_criteria: Comparable restaurant sales growth prints negative for any quarter, reversing the current two-quarter positive-traffic trend
Restaurant-level operating margin falls below 24% for two consecutive quarters
The 2026 Salmonella outbreak is linked to a Chipotle-controlled failure or the lawsuit count materially expands beyond the single Minnesota filing found
Full-year 2026 comparable-sales guidance is cut from the current low-single-digit range at the Q3 2026 report
New-unit openings fall materially below the guided 350-370 range for 2026
key_adverse_facts: Restaurant-level operating margin fell 220bps YoY and operating margin fell 250bps YoY in Q2 2026 even as comps turned positive
A first lawsuit tied to a 2026 multistate Salmonella outbreak was filed in Minnesota federal court in August 2026; Chipotle has not identified the specific supplier as of the sources reviewed
A 2024-filed securities-fraud class action naming Chipotle, former CEO Brian Niccol and food-safety officer Laurie Schalow remains pending

Reverse DCF implies ~13% p.a. 10-year FCF growth is needed to justify the current EV, well above the ~8-10% base case implied by low-single-digit comps plus ~8-9% unit growth against a still-contracting margin
data_conflicts: Triage's red flag of "three consecutive quarters of negative comps" was accurate for the 2025 data it was based on but is now partly stale: Q1 2026 (+0.5%) and Q2 2026 (+2.2%) comps, and transactions specifically, have both turned positive for two consecutive quarters
CMG.confidence_in_thesis: medium-high on the operating improvement being real, but low on the current price being justified by it
CMG.scenario_basis: Starting TTM FCF ~$1.116B; base case revenue growth ~10-12% (low-single-digit comps plus ~8-9% unit growth) with margin roughly stable rather than recovering, and multiple compressing modestly toward historical median (~23-25x NTM from current levels); bear case comps relapse negative and multiple compresses to ~18x; bull case Recipe for Growth reignites mid-single-digit-plus comps with margin recovery and multiple re-rates above 30x; no dividend, capital return is via buybacks.
